tools.name: screenslick_bridge_status
tools.description: Check whether a ScreenSlick editor is connected to the local bridge.

tools.name: screenslick_health_check
tools.description: Run a ScreenSlick MCP health check: server version, bridge configuration, editor connection, loaded project, and suggested recovery steps.

tools.name: screenslick_get_project
tools.description: Inspect the current ScreenSlick editor project.

tools.name: screenslick_analyze_timeline
tools.description: Return a compact agent-friendly summary of the current timeline, layers, voiceover/caption/music state, and likely issues.

tools.name: screenslick_review_director_draft
tools.description: Review the current project with ScreenSlick director taste rules: intro/outro placement, inset card text/voiceover timing, caption/narration readiness, music/SFX fit, visual polish, and final QA next steps. Does not mutate the editor.

tools.name: screenslick_validate_voiceover_timing
tools.description: Inspect timeline voiceover clips for overlaps, long gaps, duplicates, missing audio durations, and disabled playback.

tools.name: screenslick_find_clip_candidates
tools.description: Find promising short-form or demo clip ranges from the current timeline using narration/subtitle density and timeline structure.

tools.name: screenslick_analyze_video_segments
tools.description: Return scored timeline windows that summarize narration/subtitle density, coverage, and likely edit opportunities.

tools.name: screenslick_create_clip_collection
tools.description: Normalize selected candidate ranges into a reviewable clip collection for agents to use before slicing/exporting.

tools.name: screenslick_get_capabilities
tools.description: List ScreenSlick agent-editable commands, effect fields, animations, sound bindings, backgrounds, layouts, and workflow guidance.

tools.name: screenslick_list_voices
tools.description: List ScreenSlick local and premium voiceover voices. Premium Gemini voices consume credits and require user confirmation.

tools.name: screenslick_list_music
tools.description: List built-in ScreenSlick music tracks.

tools.name: screenslick_list_sound_effects
tools.description: List built-in ScreenSlick sound effects.

tools.name: screenslick_list_effects
tools.description: List agent-editable visual effect options.

tools.name: screenslick_remove_silences
tools.description: Run the editor's silence removal feature on the current timeline.

tools.name: screenslick_generate_transcript
tools.description: Run the editor's transcription/subtitle generation flow on the current video or timeline.

tools.name: screenslick_generate_script
tools.description: Ask ScreenSlick's script assistant to write or improve a timed narration plan.

tools.name: screenslick_director_plan
tools.description: Create a planning-first Director Mode edit plan from the current ScreenSlick project and a broad creative prompt. Does not mutate the editor.

tools.name: screenslick_create_demo_video
tools.description: Create or dry-run a safe Director Mode first-draft demo edit with editor-native silence removal, local captions, local or confirmed-premium voiceover, inset intro/outro text, camera layout polish, canvas styling, optional music, subtle motion, and automatic director review.

tools.name: screenslick_generate_voiceover
tools.description: Generate voiceover using ScreenSlick's native voiceover flow. Defaults to editable timeline voiceover clips so users can edit, move, delete, and regenerate agent-created narration. Pass mode='full-track' or editable=false only when the user explicitly wants one flattened generated voiceover track.

tools.name: screenslick_add_transcript_voiceover_to_timeline
tools.description: Add transcript or agent-provided script voiceover clips to the editable timeline. This is the preferred narration tool for agent edits.

tools.name: screenslick_clear_voiceover
tools.description: Clear generated voiceover audio and timeline voiceover clips before replacing narration.

tools.name: screenslick_replace_voiceover_clips
tools.description: Replace all timeline voiceover clips with a supplied timed clip list. Use after cleanup or when rebuilding narration from extracted on-screen captions.

tools.name: screenslick_update_voiceover_clip
tools.description: Update a single timeline voiceover clip's text, optionally regenerating its audio.

tools.name: screenslick_move_voiceover_clip
tools.description: Move one timeline voiceover clip to a new time in milliseconds. The editor may snap it to avoid overlaps.

tools.name: screenslick_delete_voiceover_clip
tools.description: Delete one timeline voiceover clip by id.

tools.name: screenslick_regenerate_voiceover_clip
tools.description: Regenerate one timeline voiceover clip with its saved voice, provider, speed, and expression settings.

tools.name: screenslick_extract_on_screen_captions
tools.description: Sample timestamped preview frames, cropped to the likely on-screen caption area by default, so a vision/OCR-capable agent can extract baked-in caption text and rebuild timed narration.

tools.name: screenslick_merge_on_screen_caption_ocr
tools.description: Merge OCR/vision readings from sampled baked-in captions into deduped timed text clips without changing the editor.

tools.name: screenslick_create_voiceover_from_on_screen_captions
tools.description: Merge OCR/vision readings from baked-in captions, then replace timeline voiceover clips with generated narration. Use dryRun=true first for review.

tools.name: screenslick_preview_voiceover
tools.description: Preview or stop the current generated ScreenSlick voiceover.

tools.name: screenslick_toggle_voiceover
tools.description: Enable or disable the current generated ScreenSlick voiceover track.

tools.name: screenslick_cleanup_timeline
tools.description: Clear selected editor timeline layers such as voiceover, music, text, effects, captions, background, and camera overlay without deleting source video clips.

tools.name: screenslick_apply_commands
tools.description: Apply a batch of validated creative edit commands to the editor timeline. Call screenslick_get_capabilities first to learn the valid command shapes and effect fields.

tools.name: screenslick_capture_frame
tools.description: Capture a Snap-style preview frame from the current editor. The local bridge saves large frame data to .tmp/agent-frames and returns filePath metadata.

tools.name: screenslick_capture_frames
tools.description: Capture many preview frames in one call: pass times (seconds), or startTime/endTime with fps. At most 60 frames per call; JPEG at 1280px wide by default (set format/maxWidth to change). Each frame is saved to a file and returned with its timeline time. Use it to find scene changes, fades, and on-screen text.

tools.name: screenslick_get_source_file
tools.description: Save the loaded source video to a local file and return its path, for ffmpeg or other analysis. Defaults to the asset under the playhead; pass assetId from screenslick_get_project to pick another. Returns companionPackageDir when the video came from a Companion recording folder on this machine. Downloads are cached by asset.

tools.name: screenslick_import_voiceover_audio
tools.description: Import your own audio files as editable timeline voiceover clips: one entry per line with an absolute file path (wav, mp3, m4a, ogg, webm, flac), startMs, and the spoken text. Text becomes the clip label and its caption. Clips can be moved, deleted, and exported like other voiceover; they cannot be regenerated, so import a new take to change a line. Set replace=true to replace all existing voiceover clips.

tools.name: screenslick_export_video
tools.description: Export the current editor project as an MP4 data URL.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_status
tools.description: Motion Studio status: workspace folder, which project the user has open, playhead and selection, the project's tracks, build errors (esbuild) and project.json/layers.json validation issues. Call it first, and after every edit to scenes or layers.json to confirm the build and files are valid.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_create_project
tools.description: Create a new Studio project (project.json, empty layers.json, scenes/, assets/, renders/, notes.md) and open it in the user's studio page. Default variants: wide 1920x1080 and mobile 1080x1920 at 30 fps.

slug.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_open_project
tools.description: Switch the user's studio page to another project.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_capture_frames
tools.description: Render frames of the project with the same in-browser renderer the export uses, saved as PNG files you can open with Read. Use it after each beat: mid-entrance, settled hold, exit. Anything the browser export can't draw (unsupported CSS) shows up here. Max 24 frames per call.

variant.description: Variant to render, e.g. "wide" or "mobile". Defaults to the one on screen.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_contact_sheet
tools.description: One PNG grid of many frames with frame/time labels: a stills sheet to review pacing and layout before export. Pass frames, or from/to/every (frames). Up to 48 frames.

variant.description: Variant to render, e.g. "wide" or "mobile". Defaults to the one on screen.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_media_info
tools.description: Duration (seconds and frames at the project fps), size, sample rate and channels of project media files. Use it to set clip durations exactly. For screen recordings with a <video>.cursor.json (ScreenSlick Companion), also returns a cursor summary: click count, the busiest stretches (where to zoom), idle stretches (cut candidates) and typing (speed-up candidates).

items.description: A project file ("assets/voice.wav") or a library file ("library:sfx/whoosh.wav").

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_transcribe
tools.description: Word timings for a voice or song file with Whisper running in the user's browser. Returns words with start/end seconds and frames. model: tiny | base (default) | small (slower, better).

path.description: A project file ("assets/voice.wav") or a library file ("library:sfx/whoosh.wav").

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_analyze_audio
tools.description: Analyze a music/voice file: tempo, beat/downbeat/strong-beat frames, onset frames, per-frame energy (full, low, high, 0..1) and loudness. Use it to cut scenes on beats and drive beat-reactive visuals.

path.description: A project file ("assets/voice.wav") or a library file ("library:sfx/whoosh.wav").

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_listen_measure
tools.description: Measure audio like a mastering meter: integrated loudness (LUFS), momentary/short-term max, loudness range, sample and true peak, onset offset (silence before the sound starts). Pass paths, or mix=true to measure the project's whole audio mix.

items.description: A project file ("assets/voice.wav") or a library file ("library:sfx/whoosh.wav").

variant.description: Variant to render, e.g. "wide" or "mobile". Defaults to the one on screen.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_listen_rank
tools.description: Rank sound files against a plain description of the sound (source + action + character, e.g. "a single crisp computer mouse click") using CLAP audio-text embeddings in the browser. Returns similarity and z-score per file (z >= 3 is a strong match). You cannot hear: use this before claiming a sound fits.

items.description: A project file ("assets/voice.wav") or a library file ("library:sfx/whoosh.wav").

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_listen_tags
tools.description: What a sound is, as AudioSet labels with probabilities (AST model in the browser), per file.

items.description: A project file ("assets/voice.wav") or a library file ("library:sfx/whoosh.wav").

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_listen_realness
tools.description: Estimate whether each file is a real recording or code-synthesized (p_real 0..1 with the evidence). Prefer p_real >= 0.5 for sound effects.

items.description: A project file ("assets/voice.wav") or a library file ("library:sfx/whoosh.wav").

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_listen_critique
tools.description: Mix the project's audio exactly as the export will and review it: loudness vs the −14 LUFS target, true peak, clipping, silent gaps, voice vs music balance, and whether each SFX lands on its cue (scene starts, markers). Returns timestamped findings to fix before export.

variant.description: Variant to render, e.g. "wide" or "mobile". Defaults to the one on screen.

fast.description: Skip the realness pass (seconds instead of a minute).

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_export
tools.description: Export MP4s (H.264/AAC) in the user's browser, loudness-normalized to −14 LUFS, into the project's renders/ folder with a cover PNG. Only export when the user asks for it. Defaults to every variant.

videoCodec.description: Default h264. vp9/av1 only if the browser has no H.264 encoder.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_focus
tools.description: Show the user something: move the studio playhead to a frame and/or select a clip (by id), optionally switching variant.

variant.description: Variant to render, e.g. "wide" or "mobile". Defaults to the one on screen.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_voice_options
tools.description: Voice-over providers the user has set up (ElevenLabs, Gemini, OpenAI, Grok/xAI), their default, models and voices. Pass provider: "elevenlabs" to list that account's voices (ids). Call before generating a voice-over. API keys are handled by the helper: never ask for them.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_generate_voice
tools.description: Generate a voice-over with the user's own provider key and save it to assets/voice/ in the project (never overwrites). Uses the user's default provider unless they named another. Returns each take's path and length. Then check the words with screenslick_studio_transcribe before using a take.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

text.description: Exactly the words to speak. No stage directions (use style).

voice.description: Voice name/id, e.g. "Puck" (Gemini), "marin" (OpenAI), "eve" (Grok), an ElevenLabs voice id.

style.description: Delivery notes (tone, pace, pronunciation). Gemini and OpenAI only.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_components
tools.description: The ScreenSlick motion component library: ready-made, export-safe animations (titles, lower thirds, stats, AI prompt boxes, …) you put on a scene track as { component, props } instead of writing a scene. Check it before building an effect yourself. Without id: search by words or category. With id: the full props (types, defaults, limits), examples and a ready clip for layers.json.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_music_catalog
tools.description: Search the ScreenSlick music library: the 200+ licensed songs hosted for the editor (energetic, chill, cinematic, electronic, ambient). Use it when the user asks for a ScreenSlick song or a library track. Filter by words in the name/category, category and length; with no filters it lists everything. Then add candidates with screenslick_studio_add_catalog_music.

query.description: Words to match in the track name or category, e.g. "glow launch".

minSeconds.description: Shortest track length you can use (the video length).

tools.name: screenslick_studio_add_catalog_music
tools.description: Copy ScreenSlick library songs (ids from screenslick_studio_music_catalog) into the project's assets/music/ so they play, analyze and export like any asset. Up to 8 at a time; skips ones already there. To choose by ear: add 3–6 candidates, rank them with screenslick_studio_listen_rank / _tags against the vibe, keep the best, delete the rest.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_music_options
tools.description: Whether Lyria music generation is available (the user's Gemini key, saved under Voices) and which models. Call before making a new song.

tools.name: screenslick_studio_generate_music
tools.description: Generate an original music bed with Google Lyria (the user's Gemini key; the helper adds it) and save it to assets/music/ (never overwrites). Write the prompt like a brief: "Instrumental only, no vocals.", total length, key and steady BPM, instruments, mix, then [m:ss - m:ss] sections that follow the video's beats (intro, build, drop on the reveal, final hit, ring-out). No artist or song names. Takes 1–3 minutes per take.

project.description: Project slug. Defaults to the project open in the studio page.

prompt.description: The music brief (see the tool description).

takes.description: Takes in parallel (default 1; 2 for anything that matters).

model.description: lyria-3.5 (default): length from the prompt. Clip: always 30 s.
